name: argus
description: High-performance configuration management framework for Go applications with zero-allocation performance, universal format support (JSON, YAML, TOML, HCL, INI, Properties), and an ultra-fast CLI powered by Orpheus.

paragraphs: High-performance configuration management framework for Go applications with zero-allocation performance, universal format support (JSON, YAML, TOML, HCL, INI, Properties), and an ultra-fast CLI powered by Orpheus.
features: Unified Entry Point: argus.Setup(...) gathers files, directories, environment, flags, remote providers and documents behind one call, with fixed precedence and atomic revisions
Documents: system prompts and skills read as text, hot-reloaded, in a namespace of their own
Typed Binding: argus.BindConfig delivers a new struct per revision, never rewriting the one in use
Universal Format Support: JSON, YAML, TOML, HCL, INI, Properties with auto-detection
ConfigWriter System: Atomic configuration file updates with type-safe operations
